covers: US close on Thursday 19 Nov 2026, JSE close 19 Nov and the rand overnight to 20 Nov 2026
headline: Wall Street closes at the day's lows: S&P 500 7,175.83 (-5.1% on the week), Nasdaq 23,879.20; rand R17.54/$ this morning
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 106,216.49 on 19 Nov 2026 (-5.5% on the week) and the Top 40 at 98,385.12 (-5.8%), and the rand was at R17.54 per dollar early on 20 Nov, 4.5% weaker than a week ago (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). In New York the sell-off deepened into the close: the S&P 500 finished at 7,175.83, below its 19:09 SAST level of 7,220.89 and 5.1% lower on the week, and the Nasdaq at 23,879.20 (-5.0% on the week), with AMD -7.7%, Amazon -3.9%, Nvidia -3.3% and Meta -3.3%, while Palo Alto Networks gained 6.4% (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 19 Nov close). Commodities fell with shares, with gold closing at $3,526.30 (-9.3% on the week), platinum at $1,296.00 and Brent at $89.79, and the US 10-year yield at 5.05%; the JSE is set to open under pressure from the US close and a weaker rand.
